verdict.rationale: The Gusto Embedded Payroll API docs describe pagination, individual payroll/contractor/time-off endpoints, webhooks, and idempotency, but there is no documented bulk/batch endpoint for creating or updating many items (employees, payrolls, contractors) in a single call. The closest evidence (contractor_payment_groups, historical data import) covers grouped or one-time imports, not general-purpose bulk operations. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoints, documentation of multi-item create/update/delete calls, and any AI-native tooling for orchestrating bulk actions.
